question: The majority of regulatory T lymphocytes express high levels of:

options.opc: The alpha chain of the receptor for IL-2.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Molecules of the B7 family -> Regulatory T lymphocytes express high levels -> 80% CHAIN: The alpha chain of the receptor for IL-2 -> Regulatory T lymphocytes express high levels -> 85% CHAIN: CD8 -> Not expressed at high levels by regulatory T lymphocytes -> Unclear -> 70% CHAIN: IL-17 -> Not expressed at high levels by regulatory T lymphocytes -> 75% CHAIN: Perforin -> Not expressed at high levels by regulatory T lymphocytes -> 80%
analysis: Regulatory T lymphocytes, also known as Tregs, are known to express high levels of molecules of the B7 family, particularly CTLA-4 (cytotoxic T-lymphocyte-associated protein 4). This molecule plays a crucial role in the suppressive function of Tregs.
